About Us

KEA Design was founded as a part of a creative agency to deliver a full service in interior architecture, design, 3D visualization, fit-outs and execution with complete efficiency and effectiveness at the highest level. From residential to commercial projects, from contemporary to traditional styles, there are no limits to the vast types of projects we take on. Innovative solutions are developed using leading edge technologies which led us to diversify our field of work, completing projects in different countries such as the UAE, Lebanon, Norway and more.
